_help: The journal's People pages, by speaker id. A page appears once that person has spoken to you (Codex.meet) or its met_if passes; each note is added when its 'if' passes. Played by scripts/sites/codex.gd and JournalScreen. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_codex.py.

eleanor.name: Eleanor Whitmore
eleanor.text: A young scholar the museum treats as an assistant. Reads ancient languages better than anyone in the building, and badly wants to be taken seriously.

notes.text: You promised her the publication, under her own name.
She came with the expedition.
She trusts you now, and says what she thinks.

pembroke.name: Dr. Arthur Pembroke
pembroke.text: Methodical and proud. His last expedition, at Wadi Natrun in 1919, went badly and took his name with it.

notes.text: You agreed: every find recorded before anyone touches it.
He came with the expedition.

hassan.name: Dr. Hassan al-Masri
hassan.text: Dismissed by the museum for insisting that whole dynasties were struck from the record. Has spent his life on Akmentar.

notes.text: He came with the expedition, on one condition: that you listen when he says a door should stay closed.
At the temple he tried to steer you away from what was written there.
He is one of the Keepers of the Veil. He ordered the attacks on the expedition, to keep anyone from the tomb.

hargreaves.name: Tom Hargreaves
hargreaves.text: An old army acquaintance, taking security contracts since he left. Once obeyed an order that left men behind, and won't again.

notes.text: He came with the expedition.
He held the rear on the last day, as he said he would.

idris.name: Idris Mahjoub
idris.text: A Sudanese gunman who guards merchants on the road south. Knows half of Cairo's thieves. His pay goes home to his sisters in Omdurman.

notes.text: He came with the expedition.
You paid him less than he asked. He remembers.

isabelle.name: Isabelle Moreau
isabelle.text: A French gunwoman with a reputation and no patience. Wouldn't follow you until you'd proved yourself.

notes.text: She came with the expedition, on her own terms.
She stays now because she wants to.

saleh.name: Saleh al-Rashidi
saleh.text: Forty years of desert roads, and his travellers come home. Expensive, careful, and not to be hurried.

notes.text: He came with the expedition.

youssef.name: Youssef Nabil
youssef.text: Young, fast, cheap and sure he will be the man who finds the road to Akmentar.

notes.text: You promised him the credit for the road.
He took the expedition down his shortcut.

farid.name: Farid Mansour
farid.text: Moves goods between Cairo and a dozen towns that aren't on the map. Treats everything as a transaction, nearly.

notes.text: He trades as the expedition goes.

mahmoud.name: Mahmoud Fawzi
mahmoud.text: His crew has dug for the British, the French and the Americans, and every one of them took the credit.

notes.text: You promised his men their names on the finds.

khalil.name: Khalil Darwish
khalil.text: A former dockworker who keeps his men in honest work. Half of them have been cheated before.

notes.text: You still owe his crew half their pay.

naguib.name: Naguib Sabet
naguib.text: Porters, camels, tents and cooks. Always packs for the way out.

karim.name: Karim Fahmy
karim.text: Efficient and careful. Made you the offer at the café and keeps the expedition's money at the bank.

notes.text: He won't talk about Blackwood's first expedition.
Pressed, he admitted it: they stopped answering, and Blackwood sent no one after them.

blackwood.name: Sir Reginald Blackwood
blackwood.text: A rich industrialist and collector who lost an expedition to Akmentar before yours.

notes.text: He confessed: Ashby came back alone, raving about a man in bronze bands, and Blackwood buried the report.
He wanted the amulet for his collection. You refused him.

freddie.name: Freddie Mallory
freddie.text: An old army friend who owes you for the last job, and half of Cairo besides. Gone, in the night.

notes.text: His note said he'd gone to Alexandria until it blows over.
You gave him away.
He came back, and paid part of what he owes in information.

landlady.name: Umm Sayed
landlady.text: Owed four months' rent, and not shy about it.

finch.name: Harold Finch
finch.text: Freddie owes him two thousand pounds, and he thinks you know where Freddie is.

notes.text: You owe him fifty within the month.
You paid him off.

musa.name: Musa Kamal
musa.text: Big, quiet, and doing unpleasant work because it pays.

notes.text: You helped him up after the fight. He hasn't forgotten.
You humiliated him. He hasn't forgotten.

archivist.name: Professor Mustafa El-Gohary
archivist.text: Irritable, brilliant, and certain that Akmentar is a camel drivers' story.

notes.text: You threatened him. You're not welcome in the museum.
He signed Hassan's ban on every antiquities export.

yacoub.name: Yacoub Ben-Ami
yacoub.text: Sells the legitimate and the less so from an office in the old quarter. Introduced you to Hassan.

mckenna.name: George McKenna
mckenna.text: A former soldier who runs a bar for adventurers and hears everything.

abdel.name: Abdel Rahman
abdel.text: If it crosses the desert, it passes through his gate.

fatima.name: Fatima el-Sayed
fatima.text: Places good workers with good employers, and remembers the bad ones.

notes.text: He reads the wires he sends, for people he trusts.

clara.name: Clara Beaumont
clara.text: Doesn't gossip about her guests. Talks about the weather, which is crowded.

notes.text: She keeps an eye on the rival expeditions for you.

hamdi.name: Captain Yusuf Hamdi
hamdi.text: Runs a steamer upriver and looks after his crew first.

fletcher.name: Captain Danny Fletcher
fletcher.text: An old friend in Alexandria with a crate that flies. Unreliable with money, very reliable in the air.

notes.text: He wrecked the thieves' booking for you.
He flew you back to Akmentar.

salim.name: Salim Farouk
salim.text: A former smuggler who sells information now. Mostly reliable.

khalaf.name: Inspector Ibrahim Khalaf
khalaf.text: Suspicious of foreigners with crates, and right to be.

notes.text: He'll send men when you find the thieves.

watkins.name: Henry Watkins
watkins.text: Keeps meticulous records of who leaves Cairo by train.

rashid.name: Rashid Amin
rashid.text: Keeps the peace in a town strangers have been asking about.

mariam.name: Mariam Amin
mariam.text: Sells water and flour at prices she swears are fair.

whitfield.name: Charlie Whitfield
whitfield.text: A loud, generous American who treats Akmentar as a race, and bets on it.

notes.text: You took his five-hundred-dollar wager.
His people took the jars and the amulet.

maggie.name: Maggie Sullivan
maggie.text: Takes the pictures and keeps Whitfield honest. Mostly.

callahan.name: Red Callahan
callahan.text: Keeps the bad men off Whitfield's investment.

adler.name: Professor Friedrich Adler
adler.text: A careful, respected archaeologist who will not let enthusiasm overrule evidence.

notes.text: His people took the jars and the amulet, for study.

kruger.name: Wilhelm Krüger
kruger.text: A young scholar in his famous superior's shadow.

vogel.name: Ernst Vogel
vogel.text: A former soldier who wants to finish his contract with nobody else dead.

bellini.name: Vittorio Bellini
bellini.text: Arrived late, quietly, expecting to profit from what the others uncovered.

notes.text: His people took the jars and the amulet, to sell.

sofia.name: Sofia Ricci
sofia.text: Knows what the artifacts are worth, and what they are.

rashad.name: Sheikh Rashad al-Khatib
rashad.role: Leader of the Keepers of the Veil
rashad.text: His family has kept watch over Akmentar for generations. Explained the amulet and the guardian, and sent you after the thieves.

notes.text: He fell holding the guardian at Akmentar.

bashir.name: Bashir Haddad
bashir.text: The man whose riders stopped expeditions on the roads to Akmentar.

notes.text: His men are the ones you fought on the way.

noura.name: Noura al-Khatib
noura.text: Rashad's niece, who knows the binding rite and thinks the Keepers' secrecy helped cause this.

notes.text: The rite was completed.

omar.name: Omar Saqr
omar.text: Raised among the Keepers. Rode against the expeditions, and hates you for the brothers he lost.

notes.text: He has started to trust you, a little.

guardian.name: The guardian
guardian.text: Bound to the amulet when it was laid in its cradle. It follows the eye wherever it is carried, and it cannot be killed.

notes.text: The sarcophagus held him down with bronze bands, like a guard posted, not a king at rest.
With the eye back in its cradle, he sleeps again.
